wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: every request names exactly one stored configuration and every view decides on that same object; there is no neighbouring or caller-supplied proxy resource to authorize instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the feature has no write path that discloses stored values; restore is the only write and already requires configure
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the decision uses the authenticated user's permission on a fixed object; no caller-supplied identity or name is parsed to make it
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: Jenkins evaluates the permission in-process and denies by default; there is no external authority lookup that can be absent
